# MCP Contract Auditor

> Audit MCP tool manifests for unsafe scopes, ambiguous side effects, missing parameter constraints, secret exposure and confirmation boundaries. Use when reviewing or publishing MCP servers, tool schemas, connectors, or agent tool contracts.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/qasimrazamalik-coder/mcp-contract-auditor
License: MIT
Primary instructions: skill/SKILL.md
Installation: docs/INSTALLATION.md
Safety guardrails: docs/GUARDRAILS.md
Security policy: SECURITY.md
Example input: examples/input.json

## Supported runtimes
Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, MCP-compatible agents, and custom agent runtimes.

## Usage
Run: python skill/scripts/run.py examples/input.json
Test: pytest -q
